properties.name: DEST_IP
properties.description: Overrides the destination IP address recorded in audit log entries. Set directly from the DEST_IP environment variable; when unset, the filter falls back to the request's local address.

properties.name: DEST_PORT
properties.description: Overrides the destination port recorded in audit log entries. Set directly from the DEST_PORT environment variable; when unset, the filter falls back to the request's local port.

properties.name: a4.okta.client.id
properties.description: OAuth client ID for the AimAhead Okta tenant, sent as HTTP Basic auth when exchanging authorization codes and introspecting tokens. Set from A4_OKTA_CLIENT_ID.

properties.name: a4.okta.client.secret
properties.description: OAuth client secret for the AimAhead Okta tenant, paired with a4.okta.client.id for HTTP Basic auth against the token and introspect endpoints. Set from A4_OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET.

properties.name: a4.okta.connection.id
properties.description: Connection identifier used to look up and tag users signing in through the AimAhead Okta provider. Set from A4_OKTA_CONNECTION_ID.

properties.name: a4.okta.idp.provider.is.enabled
properties.description: Enables the AimAhead Okta identity provider as a login method. Set from A4_OKTA_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED.

properties.name: a4.okta.idp.provider.uri
properties.description: Hostname of the AimAhead Okta tenant, used to build the OAuth token and introspect endpoint URLs; the caller prefixes it with https://. Set from A4_OKTA_IDP_PROVIDER_URI.

properties.name: api.key.allow.ungated.generation
properties.description: Explicit opt-in to allow open-access API key generation while no CAPTCHA provider is configured. Without it, enabling api.key.generation.enabled with captcha.provider=disabled fails startup. Set from API_KEY_ALLOW_UNGATED_GENERATION.

properties.name: api.key.enforcement.enabled
properties.description: Requires open-access requests to carry a valid API key before they are evaluated further; requests without one are rejected. Set from API_KEY_ENFORCEMENT_ENABLED.

properties.name: api.key.generation.enabled
properties.description: Enables the public self-service endpoint for minting open-access API keys. Set from API_KEY_GENERATION_ENABLED.

properties.name: api.key.pepper
properties.description: Secret mixed into API key hashes using HMAC-SHA256; when blank, keys are hashed with plain SHA-256 instead. Set from API_KEY_PEPPER.

properties.name: api.key.pepper.previous
properties.description: Comma-separated list of earlier pepper values tried, in order, when verifying existing HMAC-backed API keys during pepper rotation; blank entries are skipped. Set from API_KEY_PEPPER_PREVIOUS.

properties.name: api.key.platform.ttl.days
properties.description: Number of days a platform API key is valid when minted without an explicit expiry and without the neverExpires flag. Must be positive or the service fails to start. Set from API_KEY_PLATFORM_TTL_DAYS.

properties.name: api.key.session.enabled
properties.description: Enables open-access sessions: POST /open/session issues each anonymous browser a short-lived signed token to send as its API key. When off, that endpoint answers 404. Set from API_KEY_SESSION_ENABLED.

properties.name: api.key.session.max.lifetime.hours
properties.description: Hours a session can last across refreshes, after which the browser starts a new one. Must cover at least api.key.session.ttl.minutes or the service fails to start. Set from API_KEY_SESSION_MAX_LIFETIME_HOURS.

properties.name: api.key.session.signing.secret
properties.description: Base64 HS256 key that signs session tokens. Required when sessions are enabled; must decode to at least 32 bytes and must not give the same key as application.client.secret, or the service fails to start. Rotating it ends every session. Set from API_KEY_SESSION_SIGNING_SECRET.

properties.name: api.key.session.ttl.minutes
properties.description: Minutes a session token is valid. A token past half its TTL is refreshed on /open/validate. Must be positive or the service fails to start. Set from API_KEY_SESSION_TTL_MINUTES.

properties.name: api.key.user.ttl.days
properties.description: Number of days a self-service user API key remains valid. Must be positive or the service fails to start. Set from API_KEY_USER_TTL_DAYS.

properties.name: application.access.grant.email.subject
properties.description: Subject line for the access-granted notification email. When blank or equal to the literal value "none" the default subject "Your Access To <system name>" is used instead. Set from GRANT_EMAIL_SUBJECT.

properties.name: application.admin.users
properties.description: Address the denied-access notification email is sent to when a user fails to match an account during login. Set from ADMIN_USERS.

properties.name: application.client.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify JWT tokens issued by this service. Set from APPLICATION_CLIENT_SECRET; there is no default, startup fails if it is unset.

properties.name: application.client.secret.base64
properties.description: Whether application.client.secret is base64-encoded. When true, the secret is base64-decoded before it is used as the JWT signing key. Set from APPLICATION_CLIENT_SECRET_IS_BASE_64.

properties.name: application.long.term.token.expiration.time
properties.description: Lifetime in milliseconds for long-term tokens. Non-positive values fall back to 30 days. Set from LONG_TERM_TOKEN_EXPIRATION_TIME.

properties.name: application.max.session.length
properties.description: Length of time in milliseconds a user session is allowed to stay open before it is treated as expired. Non-positive values fall back to 8 hours. Set from MAX_SESSION_TIME.

properties.name: application.system.name
properties.description: Display name of the deployment, used in email subjects and bodies sent to users. Set from SYSTEM_NAME.

properties.name: application.template.path
properties.description: Directory that holds the FENCE study mapping file and the mail template files. Must end with a path separator or the FENCE mapping fails to load. Set from TEMPLATE_PATH.

properties.name: application.token.expiration.time
properties.description: Lifetime in milliseconds for short-term access tokens. Non-positive values fall back to 1 hour. Set from TOKEN_EXPIRATION_TIME.

properties.name: application.token.inclusionRoles
properties.description: Comma-separated list of role names embedded in JWT token claims. Set from TOKEN_INCLUSION_ROLES.

properties.name: application.tos.enabled
properties.description: Whether the terms-of-service gate is enforced. When false, every user is treated as having already accepted the latest terms. Set from TOS_ENABLED.

properties.name: application.user.id.claim
properties.description: Name of the JWT claim read as the user's identifier when validating a bearer token. Set from USER_ID_CLAIM.

properties.name: auth0.denied.email.enabled
properties.description: Whether a denied-access notification email is sent when an Auth0 login succeeds but no matching user account exists. Set from AUTH0_DENIED_EMAIL_ENABLED.

properties.name: auth0.host
properties.description: Base host of the Auth0 tenant. The userinfo endpoint is built by appending /userinfo. Set from AUTH0_HOST.

properties.name: auth0.idp.provider.is.enabled
properties.description: Enables the Auth0 identity provider as a login method. Set from AUTH0_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED.

properties.name: captcha.turnstile.secret
properties.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key sent to the siteverify endpoint when checking a CAPTCHA token. Required when captcha.provider is turnstile; startup fails if it is blank. Set from TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.

properties.name: captcha.turnstile.url
properties.description: URL of the Cloudflare Turnstile siteverify endpoint called to validate a CAPTCHA token. Set from TURNSTILE_SITEVERIFY_URL.

properties.name: consent.based.authorization.enabled
properties.description: Whether a request is denied when the user has no consents on file, after it otherwise passes access rule evaluation. Set from CONSENT_BASED_AUTHORIZATION_ENABLED.

properties.name: enable.public.access
properties.description: Whether open-access requests targeting an auth-backed HPDS v3 path are let through the open-access flow instead of being denied. Set from ENABLE_PUBLIC_ACCESS.

properties.name: fence.client.id
properties.description: OAuth client ID for the FENCE (Gen3) identity provider, sent as HTTP Basic auth when exchanging codes and fetching the user profile. Set from FENCE_CLIENT_ID.

properties.name: fence.client.secret
properties.description: OAuth client secret for the FENCE identity provider, paired with fence.client.id for HTTP Basic auth. Set from FENCE_CLIENT_SECRET.

properties.name: fence.idp.provider.is.enabled
properties.description: Enables the FENCE identity provider as a login method. Set from FENCE_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED.

properties.name: fence.idp.provider.uri
properties.description: Base URL of the FENCE identity provider, used to build its user-profile and OAuth token endpoint URLs. Set from FENCE_IDP_PROVIDER_URI.

properties.name: fence.standard.access.rules
properties.description: Comma-separated names of the standard access rules attached to every privilege at startup. These rules are created by database migration without a privilege attachment, and this list is what binds them. Hardcoded in application.properties; no environment variable override.

properties.name: http.proxyHost
properties.description: Hostname of the outbound HTTP proxy used for REST calls. Blank, the default, disables proxying and a direct client is used. Not mapped in application.properties; set it directly as the http.proxyHost property.

properties.name: http.proxyPassword
properties.description: Password for the outbound HTTP proxy, used only when http.proxyUser is also set. Not mapped in application.properties; set it directly as the http.proxyPassword property.

properties.name: http.proxyPort
properties.description: Port of the outbound HTTP proxy used for REST calls. Not mapped in application.properties; set it directly as the http.proxyPort property.

properties.name: http.proxyUser
properties.description: Username for the outbound HTTP proxy. Blank, the default, selects an unauthenticated proxy; a non-blank value selects an authenticated proxy using http.proxyPassword. Not mapped in application.properties; set it directly as the http.proxyUser property.

properties.name: open.idp.provider.is.enabled
properties.description: Enables the open (anonymous) identity provider. When false, open-access request validation always returns false and open-access API key generation is refused regardless of other settings. Set from OPEN_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED.

properties.name: ras.idp.uri
properties.description: Base URI of the RAS passport-validation service. A trailing slash is stripped before it is used to build the /passport/validate request URL. Set from RAS_IDP_URI.

properties.name: ras.okta.client.id
properties.description: OAuth client ID for the RAS Okta tenant, sent as HTTP Basic auth when exchanging codes and introspecting tokens. Set from RAS_OKTA_CLIENT_ID.

properties.name: ras.okta.client.secret
properties.description: OAuth client secret for the RAS Okta tenant, paired with ras.okta.client.id for HTTP Basic auth. Set from RAS_OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET.

properties.name: ras.okta.connection.id
properties.description: Connection identifier logged at startup for the RAS Okta provider. The RAS connection record itself is looked up by label rather than by this value. Set from RAS_OKTA_CONNECTION_ID.

properties.name: ras.okta.idp.provider.is.enabled
properties.description: Enables the RAS Okta identity provider as a login method. Set from RAS_OKTA_IDP_PROVIDER_IS_ENABLED.

properties.name: ras.okta.idp.provider.uri
properties.description: Hostname of the RAS Okta tenant, used to build the OAuth token and introspect endpoint URLs. Set from RAS_OKTA_IDP_PROVIDER_URI.

properties.name: ras.passport.issuer
properties.description: Expected iss claim on a GA4GH passport returned by RAS. A passport whose issuer does not match this value exactly is rejected. Set from RAS_PASSPORT_ISSUER.

properties.name: strict.authorization.applications.connections
properties.description: Comma-separated connection labels that require both access rules and privileges to authorize a request. Connections not listed only need privileges. Set from STRICT_AUTHORIZATION_APPLICATIONS.
